module_summary: 32-bit carry-lookahead adder built from two CLA_16 blocks; top-level lookahead uses their gx/px outputs to form carry c16 into the upper block and carry-out C32.

anchors.name: A
anchors.why: 32-bit operand A, split into low and high 16-bit halves for the CLA_16 children.

anchors.name: B
anchors.why: 32-bit operand B, split into low and high 16-bit halves for the CLA_16 children.

anchors.name: S
anchors.why: 32-bit sum concatenated from both CLA_16 S outputs.

anchors.name: c16
anchors.why: Lookahead carry from low block's gx into the upper CLA_16 carry-in.

anchors.name: C32
anchors.why: Final carry-out computed from upper block gx2/px2 and c16.

anchors.name: gx1
anchors.why: Representative block generate from CLA1, sole source of c16.

anchors.name: px2
anchors.why: Representative block propagate from CLA2, combined with c16 for C32.

groups.name: cla16_blocks
groups.description: Two 16-bit CLA blocks computing the low and high sum halves.

groups.name: top_lookahead
groups.description: Block-level carry lookahead producing c16 and C32 from gx/px.
